# Using AI in Research and Analysis

Course materials for an Indiana University short course on using AI and AI
agents in biomedical research.

| | |
|---|---|
| `slides/week-01/` | Week 1 Quarto/Reveal.js deck, its images and exercise materials |
| `slides/_shared/` | Shared theme and the slide-date filter |

Later weeks will be added as they are published.

Render a deck with [Quarto](https://quarto.org):

```
quarto render slides/week-01/week-01.qmd
```

Instructor: Dayu Sun (dayusun@iu.edu)
